Latest Updates
Fourteen (14) senior clerks (BS-14), are hereby Promoted as Assistant (BS-16), in the office of the Prosecutor General Sindh.  ◆  PUBLICATION OF CORRIGENDUM IN NEWSPAPERS FOR THE POST BPS-01 TO BPS-04 IN PROSECUTOR GENERAL OFFICE  ◆  Mr. Muhammad Saleem Soomro, DM-II, Law Department, is hereby designated as the focal person for coordination of administrative and logistical matters relating to CNS special courts.  ◆  The territorial limits of the jurisdiction of the special courts for the control of Narcotic substances in Karachi  ◆  The Government of Sindh is pleased to appoint Mr. Mehboob Ali Dayo, Retired District & Sessions Judge, as Presiding Officer, Control of Narcotics Substances Court (CNS-V) karachi.  ◆  The senior Civil Judges / Assistant Session Judges (BPS-19) promoted to Additional District & Session Judges (BPS-20)   ◆  Anti-Encroachment Tribunal for Shaheed Benazirabad has been established under section 12 (1) of the Sindh Public Property (removal of Encroachments) Act, 2010  ◆
